FAQ

IRIS questions, answered.

What is IRIS?

IRIS is an AI lead agent for real estate brokerages and agents, built in Dubai and used worldwide. It replies to every buyer, tenant and investor enquiry on your website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram in seconds, qualifies them, books viewings and sends hot leads to your team on WhatsApp or email.

Does IRIS work with Bayut, Property Finder and Dubizzle leads?

Yes. When a portal enquiry reaches your WhatsApp or website, IRIS replies instantly, asks the qualifying questions and books the viewing, so the lead never waits for an agent to be free.

Can IRIS answer questions about my actual listings?

Yes. IRIS is trained on your listings, communities, payment plans and FAQs. On the Scale plan it reads your full listing data, so it can match buyers to units that fit their budget and area.

Which languages does IRIS speak?

Arabic, English, Russian, Hindi, Chinese, French and 100+ more. It replies in the language the buyer writes in, automatically.

Will buyers know they are talking to AI?

IRIS introduces itself as your AI assistant and can hand the conversation to a human agent at any moment. Honest from the first message, and your team stays in control.

Can my agents take over a conversation?

Yes. Your agents get the full chat with every lead alert and can reply on WhatsApp themselves whenever they want. IRIS steps back as soon as a human joins.

How long does setup take?

Setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call, and we agree the go-live date with you on that call. We train IRIS on your listings and tone, connect your channels, test it with you and then switch it on.

How much does IRIS cost?

Starter, Growth and Scale have fixed monthly prices shown on this page, with a one-time setup fee on monthly plans. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise. Enterprise is quoted based on your volume and integrations.
